title: Rabbi Yudan bar Guriya
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: English translation and editorial notes prepared for Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: In [Sheviit, chapter 2, near the end of halakhah 3](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Sheviit.2.3.5), Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba reports that Rabbi Yudan bar Guriya waters with a basket and hoes.[^1] Perhaps he is Rabbi Yudan Giriya mentioned in [Taanit, chapter 3, halakhah 9](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Taanit.3.9.4), who said: “This Choni the Circle-Drawer was the grandson of Choni the Circle-Drawer.” [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1743&lang=en) reads Rabbi Yudan Meriya, while the entry R' Yehudah ben Pedaya reads Rabbi Yudan Gidya.

notes.text: [Penei Moshe](https://www.sefaria.org/Penei_Moshe_on_Jerusalem_Talmud_Sheviit.2.3.5.3) explains בסלא as watering with a basket, a different method used in the sabbatical year. Its next comment explains ועדר as hoeing.

[Heilprin’s Yudan entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1743&lang=en) refers readers to his [Choni entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1201&lang=en), which quotes the Yerushalmi with the form Meriya. The consulted text of [Taanit 3:9:4](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Taanit.3.9.4) has Giriya, which Guggenheimer understands as “son of proselytes.”
